PLAN line gaps are 0.45/0.40/0.50/0.62/0.40/0.70/0.60 s; words: phrases of ≤3 words, cumulative arrival at the spoken moment, clearing before the next phrase, key words amber at +18% with overshoot pop. The bed carries a v3 dynamics envelope: +2 dB swell across L5–L6, −3.5 dB dip under L7, restored for the L8 bridge.
